versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Workflow Master.

- Provides a one-stop workflow integrating content creation, data analysis, automation, and report generation.
- Built-in workflows for content pipelines, data analysis, report generation, competitor monitoring, and customer service automation.
- Triggered by common automation keywords such as "帮我搞定", "AI工作流", "批量处理", and more.
- Minimal user input required; AI infers most needs and optimizes output (content packs, analysis reports, etc.).
- Supports custom workflow definitions and best practices for efficient, reliable AI-assisted work.
